Definitions.Name: Dynamic Aspect
Text: You can use any aspects that are accessible from the base Aspects of any of your talents.
For example, if you have a Spell talent which by base (Not from any special conditions, such as Type Extension) can use Fire, then you can use Fire for a Dynamic Spell ability.

Definitions.Name: Strength
Text: Physical Attack Stat
Strength represents your physical strength, particularly when it comes to short bursts.
Those high in strength are often capable of feats such as lifting large objects or slaying large beasts.
Characters with high Strength usually have a particular stubbornness to them, while those with low strength may second-guess themselves.
Effects:
Strike Power increase (Physical Attack).
Reduced Burden (Accuracy increase*) for Physical Weapons.

Definitions.Name: Fortitude
Text: Physical Defense Stat
Fortitude represents your endurance and your ability to weather through physical hardships.
Those with higher fortitude find themselves getting sick far less than usual.
Characters with high Fortitude might be more resistant to pain or sickness, while those with low Fortitude might even find themselves getting sick or nauseous after being moved around or teleported.
Effects:
Strike Defense increase (Physical Defense).
Carry weight increase.

Definitions.Name: Will
Text: Magical Attack Stat
Will represents the strength of your focus, and your proficiency in wielding magic.
Those with high will have excellent and often subconscious control of the metaphysical, making it synonymous with someone’s luck.
Characters with high Will generally tend to be more focused, while those with low Will can have trouble controlling their attention.
Effects:
Spell Power increase (Magical Attack)
Reduced Burden (Accuracy increase*) for Magical Weapons.

Definitions.Name: Intuition
Text: Magical Defense Stat
Intuition represents the ability to deduce truth, and a resistance to magical hardships.
Those with a high intuition are often knowledgeable about magical and mystical affairs.
Characters with high Intuition generally tend to be calm and collected, while those with low intuition may end up being particularly erratic.
Effects:
Spell Defense increase (Magical Defense)

Definitions.Name: Ego
Text: Mental Attack Stat
Ego represents self-confidence and assertiveness.
It relates to your ability to hold a strong presence in a room and persuade others, as well as your ability to lie.
Characters with high Ego tend to talk highly of themselves and others, or they may boast and lie to their heart’s content, while those with low Ego might self-degrade or be unable to stand lies.
Effects:
Word Power increase (Mental Attack)
Reduced Burden (Accuracy Increase*) for Mental Weapons

Definitions.Name: Mystique
Text: Mental Defense Stat
Mystique represents a level of knowledge which makes one resistant to mental manipulation.
Those with a high mystique have a certain uniqueness and aura about them, and they often have an advanced knowledge of politics and worldly affairs.

Characters with high Mystique often find that others are attracted to them naturally, and they might act more mysterious, while those with low Mystique usually have their emotions plain to see, and others may largely disregard them.
Effects:
Word Defense increase (Mental Defense)

Definitions.Name: Control
Text: Base Accuracy Stat
Control represents precision and accuracy in your actions, as well as your muscle memory.
Those with high control often have good handwriting, and are capable of describing things down to even the most granular detail.
Characters with high Control are often very particular about the way they do things, though they do them well, while those with low Control are often haphazard and sometimes even reckless.
Effects:
Base Accuracy increase

Definitions.Name: Tempo
Text: Base Dodge Stat
Tempo represents reflexes and the ability to react and adapt quickly.
Those with a high tempo can think and perceive the world at a faster speed. They are able to follow much faster situations, such as seeing in clear detail fast-moving objects.
Characters with high Tempo are very active physically, though they may struggle to stay still, while those with low Tempo tend to be more sedentary, and may dislike exercise.
Effects:
Dodge increase (easier to evade attacks)
Speed increase (Base Movement per turn)

Definitions.Name: Vitality
Text: Physical HP
Max Vitality is equal to 2x Strength + 2x Fortitude
Vitality represents how much your body can take before it collapses.
It is reduced when you take Physical Damage.
When your Vitality reaches or is at zero:
Any further Physical damage taken overflows to your Resolve.
You cannot perform Physical actions (Strike abilities)
If your movement form is Physical, you cannot move.
If all three of Vitality, Mana, and Resolve are at zero, you enter Death throes.

Definitions.Name: Mana
Text: Magical HP
Max Mana is equal to 2x Will + 2x Intuition
Mana represents how much your soul can take before it extinguishes.
It is reduced when you take Magical Damage.
When your Mana reaches or is at zero:
Any further Magical damage taken overflows to your Vitality.
You cannot perform Magical actions (Spell abilities)
If your movement form is Magical, you cannot move.
If all three of Vitality, Mana, and Resolve are at zero, you enter Death throes.

Definitions.Name: Resolve
Text: Mental HP
Max Resolve is equal to 2x ||Ego|| + 2x ||Mystique||
Resolve represents how much your mind can take before it breaks.
It is reduced when you take Mental Damage.
When your Resolve reaches or is at zero:
Any further Mental damage taken overflows to your ||Mana||.
You cannot perform Mental actions (Word abilities)
If your movement form is Mental, you cannot move.
If all three of Vitality, Mana, and Resolve are at zero, you enter Death throes.

Definitions.Name: Energy
Text: Action Points
Max Energy is equal to 2x ||Control|| + 2x ||Tempo||
Energy represents how much you can do before overextending yourself.
You expend Energy in order to perform actions
Unless otherwise specified, you recover 8 Energy at the beginning of your turn, and you can use up to 16 Energy per turn (known as Turn Energy).
When your Energy reaches or is at zero:
You cannot move or perform actions, and you will collapse if you were doing something.
Regardless of Movement Type, if your Energy falls to zero, you collapse.
If all three of Vitality, Mana, and Resolve are at zero, you enter Death throes.

Definitions.Name: Speed
Text: How many feet you can move per turn. You can move all at once, or in multiple separate bursts.
Base Speed is equal to 24 + 1x Tempo, though it can be increased in a variety of ways.
Maximum Movement is *usually* equal to your Speed. Things which would increase or lower Max Movement do NOT affect Speed.
If the Dynamic of your Movement Form is at zero, you cannot move.

Definitions.Name: Strike
Text: A Physical attack or action.
If either your Vitality or Energy are at zero, you cannot use Strike abilities.

Definitions.Name: Spell
Text: A Magical attack or action.
If either your Mana or Energy are at zero, you cannot use Spell abilities.

Definitions.Name: Word
Text: A Physical attack or action.
If either your Resolve or Energy are at zero, you cannot use Word abilities.

Definitions.Name: Action
Text: An action taken, usually during your turn, by expending Energy and Turn Energy

Definitions.Name: Reaction
Text: An action taken outside of your turn, by expending Energy. They can be used whenever their Trigger event occurs.
Unless otherwise stated, Reactions do not expend Turn Energy, only your Energy.

Definitions.Name: Melee Actions
Text: An attack or action which utilizes your Reach (Melee range).
Base Reach for melee weapons is 8 feet (2 tiles).
Using Weapons with higher Reach values allows you to hit further.
Generally, this requires you to get up-close and personal.
Melee attacks are easier to guarantee a hit with, as in order to dodge a Melee attack, you have to leave the entirety of the attacker's Reach.

Definitions.Name: Ranged Actions
Text: A projectile attack or action which hits from farther away, based on your weapon's Range (projectile range).
Ranged Weapons have varying Ranges.
Using Weapons with higher Range values allows you to hit further.
Generally, this lets you get away with staying away from combat, though projectiles are easier to get out of the way of than Melee or AoE attacks.

Definitions.Name: Area of Effect Actions
Text: An attack or action which hits several targets within a designated area.
AoE actions have varying AoEs. Unless otherwise specified, the AoE is centered around the caster.
AoE actions can only be avoided by fully moving out of their area of effect. This makes large AoEs very effective against targets with a high Tempo.
Common AoE keywords:
Cone/Conical: A radial cone extending from point of origin a number of feet equal to its radius, with a width between 45 and 90 degrees unles otherwise specified.
Line/Linear: A line extending a number of feet equal to its radius, hitting all targets within that line regardless of whether one of them would block it.
Circle/Radial: Hits everything within the radius of the origin.
